tools.name: get_conversations
tools.description: [metadata_query] Conversation-level metadata for the given conversation_ids: id, title, started_at, ended_at, duration_seconds, participants, language_code. No transcript, brief, or summary body.

tools.name: get_transcripts_by_participant
tools.description: [content_fetch] Transcript lines associated with participant_ids in conversation_ids. Turns participant metadata into transcript evidence for exposed search results.

tools.name: get_brief
tools.description: [content_fetch] Per-conversation compact report body for the given conversation_ids using Brief -> Summary -> Standard, where Standard is the first completed non-empty type=0 report.

tools.name: get_summaries
tools.description: [content_fetch] Per-conversation summary body. With summary_ids, fetch exact summary reports from search_recordings. With conversation_ids only, fetch the latest summary report for each conversation. Paginated (offset).

tools.name: get_transcripts
tools.description: [content_fetch] Verbatim transcript of ONE recording by conversation_id. Paginated (offset / next_offset) — page through for more.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: [metadata_query] List recordings by time window / participants. Returns id, title, started_at, ended_at, duration_seconds, participants, language_code (no content). Paginated (count default 100, max 200; offset). order_by ranks within the window. NOTE: `participants` are speaker labels — placeholder

tools.name: search_recordings
tools.description: [search] Unified recording search. Runs bounded searches over transcript lines, topic segments, memory atoms, participant metadata, titles, briefs, summaries, and action items in one call. Returns typed hits plus conversation_ids, line_ids, segment_ids, memory_atom_ids, participant_ids, brief_ids, s

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_transcripts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "[content_fetch] Verbatim transcript of ONE recording by conversation_id. Paginated (offset / next_offset) — page through for more." → after: "[content_fetch] Verbatim transcript of ONE recording; at most 100 lines / 4000 characters per page. Resume using both next_offset and next_text_offset from the returned item, including within a long line."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
